QCOM.text: Closed $176.86 (+1.4%) on the verdict, with RSI 28, holding its support cluster of the 50-day ($174.15), the 20-day low ($171.02) and the 200-day ($169.36). The 20-day ($185.08) is the first resistance. The Delaware jury found Arm breached Qualcomm's licence by withholding software patches and tools, and interfered with Qualcomm's relationship with Meta. It ruled for Arm on five other claims and awarded nominal damages of $2. The finding matters more than the damages: Judge Noreika still has to rule on whether Qualcomm can stop paying Arm royalties for five years, which is worth billions and has no date yet, and an appeal is likely. Earnings est. Nov 4.

Oct 29: Intel and Sandisk (confirmed), Amazon (est.). Nov 2: Palantir (confirmed), Apple (est.). Nov 3: AMD and Astera (confirmed). Nov 4: Arm (confirmed) and Qualcomm (est.). Nov 5: MP Materials (confirmed). Not yet scheduled: Judge Noreika's ruling on Qualcomm's possible five-year royalty relief from Arm.
